author: Bobby Grayson
description: BEAM dispatch keys on the callback (handle_cast/handle_call/handle_info are separate functions) while the Lean beh is one match, so an info catch-all like '| _, _, .watchdog s_0 s_1, _ => ...' would shadow a crash clause if emitted first. ordered/1 splits a module's clauses into (cast|call) ++ info, each group in source order; insert_crashes/2 puts the crash clauses between the groups. A strict call-then-cast sort was rejected because Bank's generated file has handle_cast clauses before its handle_call clause and would no longer be byte-identical. classify/2 keys each {module, tag} by kind (every @type call alternative is a call tag even without a handle_call clause); a tag handled by two kinds is a hard fail('message tag ... handled by both ...'). Documented in the to_lean.exs header comment 'Unhandled messages (effects mode only)'. Visible effect in Gen/Watchdog.lean: the .pong clauses now precede the .start clause.
title: Clause ordering in to_lean.exs ordered/1 + insert_crashes/2: per module cast/call clauses in source order, then crash clauses, then handle_info clauses; relative cast-vs-call order irrelevant under kind-disjoint-tags assumption
